name: Noir -Wiz Koi no Mahou-
original_name: ノアーる -wiz 恋の魔法-
source:
Final exams of high school are approaching. Main character makes a wish under a shooting star to date a classmate, and a magical girl falls from the sky! The girl urges to let her live at boy's house. And in return she is going to help with love affairs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高中期末考试即将到来。主人公对着流星许愿，希望能与一位同班同学交往，结果一名魔法少女从天而降！女孩坚持要住进男孩家里，并承诺作为回报帮他解决恋爱问题。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-april-2008-gouen-no-soleil.html]vndbreview[/url]]
